model_outputs: The convolution of two functions f(t) and g(t) is given by f(t) _\ast g(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(\tau) g(t-\tau) d\tau. question: A 6 × 19 IPS rope of diameter 1 7/8 in. is used to lift a load of 8.0 tons from a depth of 760 ft. at a speed of 1500 fpm attained in 10 sec. Calculate the percentage increase in the starting load if a slack of 1 ft. is introduced on the rope.
